messages:
Maya L: heads-up — planning ap-southeast-2 (apse2) GPU cluster bring-up for 2026-04-15. Need to lock quota + short-term reservation plan. Who owns quota requests?

Aj K: I can drive the quota requests. What's our target inventory and timeline?

Maya L: Goal: bootstrap stage for dev/canary: 8x A100-80GB (on-demand) by D-14, initial staging pool 64x A100 by D-7, production commit 256x (mix of A100 + H100) over month-1. Need soft reservation earlier to avoid capacity scramble.

Sophie C: callout — for apse2 some zones only have H100 limited. Recommendation: request per-zone soft quota + regional reservation. Also ask for a "capacity hold"/reservation token from the provider (if available).

Diego R: ops checklist idea: 1) quota ticket template, 2) reservation request (console/API), 3) billing center & tags, 4) onboarding smoke tests, 5) handoff doc & runbook.

Aj K: Drafting the quota/support template now. Use this as the body when opening cloud support: 

```
Subject: Quota increase & capacity reservation request — ap-southeast-2 — Redwood Inference
Body:
Account: redwood-inference-prod (billing ID: 0123-XXXX)
Requested by: Aj K (eng-infra)
Requested increase: GPUs: +320 (target 256 steady; +64 buffer) -> prefer A100-80GB and H100 mix; per-zone breakdown: apse2-a: 120 A100, apse2-b: 120 H100, apse2-c: 80 A100
Reservation window: 2026-04-01 -> 2026-07-01 (initial)
Reason: Cluster bring-up for inference fleet expansion; we will run production LLM inference. Contact: maya@redwood.ai, aj@redwood.ai
Cost center tag: infra-apac-apse2
Please provide reservation token / Commitment ID and point-of-contact for capacity verification.
```

Sophie C: nice. Add a note to request preemption/spot exclusion for the reserved pool (we need steady capacity). Also ask for an exportable reservation ID.

Maya L: timeline constraints — cloud providers need 3–6 weeks for hard reservations in APAC. Start now. I'll notify sales/partnerships if we need committed capacity discounts.

infra-bot: (automated) created internal task INF-4823: "apse2 reservation — quota ticket" assigned to Aj K. Due 2026-03-28.

Aj K: opened support ticket 2026-03-20 -> provider case #CASE-apse2-9012. They asked for usage pattern + peak TPU window. Uploaded load profile and expected qps.

Diego R: validation plan for post-reservation: 
- Step 1: allocation smoke (8 instances), run container hello-world + model bootstrap (5 minutes)
- Step 2: perf probe (synthetic tokens at 1000 concurrent reqs across 8 GPUs)
- Step 3: KV-cache warmup test (simulate long chats, check mem & eviction)
- Step 4: network e2e (cross-zone latency alpha)
- Step 5: cost check (sample hour burn vs estimate)

Maya L: acceptance criteria for handoff to SRE: 
- Instances reachable via private VPC and console, SSH / SSM access validated
- GPU drivers and runtime match infra baseline (cuda 12.x, cuDNN X, driver y)
- Batching latency within 10% of expected profile
- Reservation token validated & billing tags applied
- Observability: metrics flow into console (per-token cost, GPU utilization)

Sophie C: add a rollback trigger: if we see >20% variance in latency or >30% cost overrun during first 48h, auto-scale down and open incident.

Aj K: provider responded: can soft-lock 200 GPUs now, hard reservation requires commit contract. They supplied a provisional reservation token: res-apse2-202603-zz99. Ask procurement for the contract review.

Maya L: procurement ping: @procurement please start the committed-use contract review for res-apse2-202603-zz99 — we might accept 6-month term. Tag to billing center infra-apac-apse2.

Diego R: cost note — projected monthly incremental: ~$1.4M for 256x A100 mix (on-demand). With 6-month commit could drop ~28%. We'll need finance sign-off.

Sophie C: small ops trick: stage with mixed instance families. Keep 10% as on-demand fallback in another region for burst/safety.

Aj K: updated support case with per-zone fallback plan and the bootstrap smoke schedule. Provider says they will confirm capacity 2026-03-30.

infra-bot: (automated) support case update: CASE-apse2-9012 -> provider reply at 2026-03-25: "We can provision soft-lock 200 GPUs in apse2 for D-30, please confirm allocation by 2026-03-31."

Maya L: action items: 
- Aj: finalize contract & quota ticket (due 2026-03-28)
- Diego: prepare acceptance test scripts and cost estimate (due 2026-03-29)
- Sophie: update runbook w/ rollback triggers & observability checks (due 2026-03-27)
- Maya: coordinate handoff call with SRE + Product on 2026-04-02

Aj K: noted. Will post the ticket links + reservation token here when contract confirmed.

Sophie C: also adding a short snippet to the onboarding runbook to validate reservation via cloud CLI: 

```
# example (GCP reservation check)
gcloud compute reservations describe res-apse2-202603-zz99 --region=asia-southeast2
# should return: status: ACTIVE, committed: 200 GPUs, instanceTypes: nvidia-a100
```

Maya L: perfect. If provider can't hard-reserve full amount by D-7 we fallback to multi-region spread and enable autoscale-burst policy.

Diego R: last thought — capture the provider POC email/phone in the ticket for quick escalation. Also save reservation IDs in our encrypted infra secrets store with tag "reservation/apse2/2026".

Maya L: agreed. thanks all — will follow up after procurement update. :thumbsup:
